 Latest news Social Security When will Social Security field offices be closed in November? Know the alternatives for those days
 Like other government agencies, the Social Security Administration observes the 11 federal holidays which means offices will be closed. 
 Kevin Dietsch Greg Heilman Calum Roche twitter Update: Nov 1st, 2026 02:28 EST Share Make us preferred on Google There are over 1,200 Social Security Administration local field offices across the United States and its territories that serve the public from Monday to Friday throughout the year. However, these offices will be closed on two days in November 2026: Veterans Day on Wednesday, Nov. 11, and Thanksgiving Day on Thursday, Nov. 26. 
 The dual federal holiday is one of the eleven days recognized as public holidays by the U.S. government. On these days all federal offices are closed, along with the post offices , across the nation giving public employees a paid day off.
 Alternatives to visiting a Social Security office
 If you need to access SSA services on a federal holiday or over the weekend you can either use the my Social Security app or the automated phone system by calling 800-772-1213. 
 If you need to speak to a Social Security representative, you can call 800-772-1213 between 8 a.m. and 7 p.m. local time on weekdays that aren’t federal holidays. You can also contact your local office on weekdays between 9 a.m. and 4 p.m., again, as long as it is not a federal holiday. 
 You can find the telephone number of the office closest to you by using the SSA’s office locator tool . Simply type your ZIP code in the search field under “Find an office near you.”
